conditional_bindings.effect: Split into chunks up to 65535 sectors with byte stride 0x01fffe00 and LBA stride 0xffff.
Use the input block LBA as command argument and set host block size 512. Otherwise use LBA << 9 and card block size.
Use CMD17. For op2 with any other count, use CMD18.
Skip DMA descriptor setup. Other strategies invoke 0x3ffe6090 and its supported DMA mode is 2.
Process controller error summary, skipping normal completion branch.
Collect response words when configured. If card context RCA nonzero and response type 1, check the first response word against 0xfdfc8080.

conditional_bindings.condition: host interrupt status & 0x20, data pointer nonzero and operation == 2
conditional_bindings.effect: Read FIFO words into the destination using 0x3ffe6344.
Run DMA bookkeeping and record transfer completion. A read descriptor uses response type 1 and takes the ordinary zero-status path.
Store table entry word +0xc in 0x3fffa800 and return from the loader.

scope: Verified packaged M0 only. Command numbers and status interpretations refer to the decoded code path; observed program order is static. Cold-load argument provenance and transport completion are checked. Boot ROM, external hardware policy, core memory setup, address alias behavior and post-release execution are outside this window. No image digest, signature verification or corresponding acceptance gate was identified in the traced transfer and loader-success path. The response mask checks card status and is separate from image authentication. Timeout leaves the wait loop on a nonzero poll result. This path reads the descriptor byte afterward; timeout alone does not establish controller cancellation. angr output is genuine and unchanged. Inferred declarations, stack arguments, MMIO offsets and control-flow expressions may be inaccurate; use the original-byte assembly and targeted checks for conclusions.
